claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_incoming_attack_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's curse deterministically changes who a ranged-weapon attack targets. The current surface can encode the resistance rider honestly, but it has no atom or subgraph for forced target substitution on an already-declared incoming attack.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.
